campaigns.name: Manila Wine Collector's Choice
campaigns.headline: A Philippines Edition, Chosen by You
campaigns.intro_copy: We are exploring a new Manila Wine collector’s edition inspired by the Philippines—only 100 individually numbered bottles. Before production begins, we are inviting our community to choose the design.
campaigns.story_copy: This edition is being created for collectors who want something genuinely rare and distinctly Filipino. Review each concept, choose the design that speaks to you, and help decide which artwork moves forward. Only one vote is allowed per person.

designs.title: Concept 01 — Archipelago Heritage
designs.subtitle: Flora, Fauna & Sunburst Gold
designs.description: Lush tropical foliage and Philippine biodiversity intertwined with baroque filigree and the iconic Philippine eight-rayed sun in lustrous embossed gold.
designs.alt_text: Four views of Johnnie Walker Blue Label bottle featuring golden Philippine flora, sunburst motif, and exotic fauna illustration on deep amber glass.

designs.title: Concept 02 — Pearl of the Orient
designs.subtitle: Maritime Azure & Coral Reefs
designs.description: Deep oceanic cobalt and cerulean gradients depicting Tubbataha Reefs and Philippine marine sanctuary life across the four bottle facets.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle with vibrant turquoise and cobalt blue marine life, coral reefs, and oceanic waves wrapped around the square glass.

designs.title: Concept 03 — Indigenous Tapestry
designs.subtitle: Yakan & Inabel Geometric Weaves
designs.description: Honoring centuries of Philippine master weavers with intricate geometric Inabel and Yakan tribal patterns rendered in etched gold and rich ruby pigments.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle featuring traditional Philippine handwoven geometric tapestry patterns in gold and deep crimson.

designs.title: Concept 04 — Manila Sunset Elegance
designs.subtitle: Golden Hour Over Manila Bay
designs.description: Warm cinnabar, ochre, and burnished gold gradients capturing the legendary sunset of Manila Bay with historic Spanish colonial arches.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle showcasing a dramatic Manila Bay sunset gradient in warm gold, terracotta, and amber with silhouettes of Intramuros.

designs.title: Concept 05 — Golden Harvest Terroir
designs.subtitle: Rice Terraces & Tropical Highlands
designs.description: The monumental Banaue Rice Terraces carved into mountain mist, celebrating northern highland craftsmanship and fertile Philippine valleys.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle illustrating tiered emerald and gold Banaue rice terraces with mountain clouds and indigenous farming heritage.

designs.title: Concept 06 — Island Fiesta & Floral Tapestry
designs.subtitle: Baroque Festivity & Sampaguita
designs.description: Vibrant celebration of nationwide festivities featuring sweet national Sampaguita blooms, cascading bougainvillea, and ceremonial gold trim.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle adorned with blooming Philippine sampaguita flowers, festive fiesta ribbons, and filigree gold leaf.

designs.title: Concept 07 — Oceanic Depths & Whale Shark
designs.subtitle: Gentle Giants of Donsol
designs.description: A serene tribute to the gentle Butanding (whale shark) gliding through translucent cyan waters alongside school of reef fishes.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle featuring majestic whale sharks swimming through azure Philippine waters with deep-sea topography.

designs.title: Concept 08 — Philippine Sun & Liberty Gold
designs.subtitle: The 8-Rayed Sun in Radiant Leaf
designs.description: Bold minimalist luxury featuring the eight rays of the Philippine flag sun boldly wrapped across the shoulder and corners in textured gold leaf.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle highlighting the Philippine golden sun emblem embossed prominently on the glass shoulder and diagonal banner.

designs.title: Concept 09 — Emerald Cordillera & Highlands
designs.subtitle: Pristine Mountain Peaks
designs.description: Rich malachite greens and deep spruce tones evoking the towering pine ridges and mystical peaks of the northern Luzon Cordilleras.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle depicting lush Cordillera pine forests and mountain ridges in rich emerald green with gold accents.

designs.title: Concept 10 — Tropical Biodiversity Bloom
designs.subtitle: Endemic Wildlife & Orchids
designs.description: The Philippine Eagle, Tarsier, and rare Vanda sanderiana (Waling-waling) orchid harmoniously composed in detailed naturalist line art.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle featuring detailed naturalist illustrations of the Philippine Eagle, Tarsier, and Waling-waling orchid.

designs.title: Concept 11 — Treasures of the Philippines
designs.subtitle: Constellation Chart & National Landmarks
designs.description: Dark midnight celestial navigation chart tracing the archipelago from Batanes to Tubbataha, Bohol tarsier, Banaue, Siargao, and Mount Apo with illuminated coordinates.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle featuring a dark celestial constellation map with Philippine island coordinates, iconic landmarks, and golden linework.

designs.title: Concept 12 — Bakunawa (The Moon Eater)
designs.subtitle: Mythology, Moon Phases & Celestial Ocean
designs.description: A dramatic and sculptural homage to the legendary Philippine celestial serpent, Bakunawa, emerging from tidal swells beneath moon phases, constellations, and starry Philippine skies.
designs.alt_text: Four views of Johnnie Walker Blue Label bottle featuring the mythological Bakunawa moon-eating dragon serpent with lunar phases and ocean waves.

designs.title: Concept 13 — Sarimanok (Messenger of Fortune)
designs.subtitle: Flowing Feathers & Okir-Inspired Jewel Filigree
designs.description: An elegant ornamental tribute to the fabled Maranao Sarimanok, adorned in flowing jewel-toned plumes, okir-inspired curves, holding a fish, and soaring beneath the Philippine sun.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle featuring the mythical Sarimanok bird with vibrant turquoise, sapphire, and crimson feathers and golden okir filigree.

designs.title: Concept 14 — Ani (The Golden Harvest)
designs.subtitle: Philippine Folk-Art Heritage & Everyday Icons
designs.description: A vibrant Philippine folk-print celebration of community and bounty, featuring the hardworking carabao, emerald rice terraces, the Philippine tarsier, a festive jeepney, basketball, and glowing Christmas parol.
designs.alt_text: Four views of bottle illustrated in bold Philippine folk-art style depicting the carabao, rice terraces, jeepney, basketball, and Christmas parol.

after_state.intro_copy: We are exploring a new Manila Wine collector’s edition inspired by the Philippines—only 100 individually numbered bottles. Before production begins, we are inviting our community to choose the design.
after_state.story_copy: This edition is being created for collectors who want something genuinely rare and distinctly Filipino. Review each concept, choose the design that speaks to you, and help decide which artwork moves forward. Only one vote is allowed per person.
